1-first-macro.title: Install it and open your favorite app with one key
1-first-macro.sum: Download it, grant the permissions, keep the Engine running, then build your first macro: one hot key that opens the app you use every day

2-type-less.title: Type a few letters, get a whole paragraph
2-type-less.sum: The address, intro or reply you type every day goes into a typed string trigger: type a few letters and the whole text appears

3-one-key-routine.title: One key, a whole routine
3-one-key-routine.sum: Turn the clicks you make every morning into one macro: open a few apps and a web page, put the windows in place, then learn to stop it and where to look when it misfires

0-what.title: What Keyboard Maestro is
0-what.sum: Automation for the Mac: you write macros in the editor and the Engine runs them in the background. Every macro is a when plus a what

1-groups.title: Macro groups: where macros work
1-groups.sum: A macro group is a folder that also decides when its macros are live: only in certain apps, only after you activate it, or shown as a palette

2-triggers.title: Triggers: when a macro starts
2-triggers.sum: A hot key, a typed string, a time of day, an app launching, a Wi-Fi network, a new file in a folder: pick the moment that feels natural

3-actions.title: Actions: what a macro does
3-actions.sum: Typing, keystrokes, menus, apps, windows, clicks and files: meet the dozen actions you'll use most and search for the rest when you need them

4-variables.title: Variables, conditions and loops: macros that adapt
4-variables.sum: Remember some text, ask you a question, take a different path depending on what's on screen, wait for something to happen: a macro stops being a fixed string of keystrokes

5-clipboard.title: The clipboard: everything you copied is still there
5-clipboard.sum: Clipboard history lets you paste what you copied earlier, named clipboards keep a few things for good, and filters change text before you paste

6-debug.title: When a macro doesn't work
6-debug.sum: Check permissions and the Engine first, then whether the group is active. Still stuck? Step through with the debugger or read the Engine log

7-advanced.title: Going further: scripts, subroutines, syncing and sharing
7-advanced.sum: Hook in shell scripts, AppleScript and JavaScript, turn repeated steps into subroutines, sync between two Macs, and share macros with others

howto.text-snippets: Turn the things you type often into abbreviations
howto.insert-date: Insert today's date with one key
howto.fill-form: Fill in the same form with one key
howto.app-hotkeys: Jump to an app with one key
howto.window-layout: Put your windows where you want them
howto.menu-shortcut: Give a menu command a shortcut it doesn't have
howto.watch-folder: File things away as soon as they land in a folder
howto.click-image: Find a button on screen and click it
howto.ocr-text: Read the text off your screen
howto.daily-schedule: Run something at the same time every day
howto.wifi-usb: Do something when you join a Wi-Fi network or plug in a device
howto.ask-input: Ask a question before doing the work
howto.palette: Make a row of buttons that run macros
howto.sync-macs: Use the same macros on two Macs

宏.label: macro
宏.tip: One small job in Keyboard Maestro: triggers decide when it starts and a list of actions says what it does.

宏组.label: macro group
宏组.tip: A folder of macros that also decides in which apps, and when, its macros are active.

触发器.label: trigger
触发器.tip: What starts a macro: pressing a hot key, typing a string, a time of day, an app launching…

动作.label: action
动作.tip: One step a macro takes, like typing some text, choosing a menu item or opening a file.

编辑器.label: editor
编辑器.tip: The Keyboard Maestro window where you write and change macros. You can quit it when you're done and your macros keep working.

引擎.label: Engine
引擎.tip: Keyboard Maestro Engine, the half that runs in the background and actually performs your macros. If it isn't running, nothing fires.

热键.label: hot key
热键.tip: A key combination that fires a macro, like ⌃⌥⌘T. Pick one no other app already uses.

输入字符串触发器.label: typed string trigger
输入字符串触发器.tip: Fires when you type a string, like =addr=, where you're typing text, and usually deletes what you typed before the macro runs.

面板.label: palette
面板.tip: A floating panel of buttons on screen, one per macro, that runs the macro when clicked.

状态菜单.label: status menu
状态菜单.tip: Keyboard Maestro's icon in the menu bar. Open it to run macros or cancel the ones that are running.

变量.label: variable
变量.tip: A named piece of text a macro stores so later actions can use it by name.

令牌.label: token
令牌.tip: A placeholder in text, like %LongDate%, that's replaced when the macro runs: today's date, the front app, the clipboard.

计算.label: calculation
计算.tip: In almost any box that wants a number you can type a formula, functions included, like half the screen width.

条件.label: condition
条件.tip: Something a macro checks: whether an app is running, whether an image is on screen, whether a variable has a value.

剪贴板历史.label: clipboard history
剪贴板历史.tip: Keyboard Maestro remembers what you've copied, so you can pick an earlier item and paste it again.

命名剪贴板.label: named clipboard
命名剪贴板.tip: A separate clipboard with a name, which your next copy won't overwrite.

找图.label: found image
找图.tip: Finding a spot on screen that matches an image you give it, so a macro can click it or wait for it.

辅助功能权限.label: Accessibility permission
辅助功能权限.tip: A setting in macOS Privacy & Security. Keyboard Maestro needs it to see your hot keys, and to type, choose menus and move windows for you.

智能组.label: smart group
智能组.tip: A saved search that lists every macro matching it, such as the ones you changed recently.

子程序.label: subroutine
子程序.tip: A macro other macros can call, with parameters. Put steps you repeat in one and call it wherever you need them.

宏库.label: Macro Library
宏库.tip: A set of ready-made macros that comes with Keyboard Maestro. Import one and adapt it.

插件动作.label: plug-in action
插件动作.tip: An action you write yourself or download from someone else, install into Keyboard Maestro, and use like a built-in one.

调试器.label: debugger
调试器.tip: A tool that runs a macro one step at a time, so you can see where it goes wrong.

引擎日志.label: Engine log
引擎日志.tip: The Engine's running record. When a macro fails, look here for the errors it reported.
